card.name: Partway through interleukin and proper names
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'interleukin' just before a hyphen and number (interleukin-1, -2). It also fires partway through some proper names like Tuscany or François.

modes.label: Interleukin before number
modes.description: The 'in' ending of interleukin, right before '-1' or '-2'.

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: Middle of a place or personal name split into pieces.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med
